# Instalar librerías
install.packages("caTools")
install.packages("caret")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("corrplot")

# Cargar librerías
library(caTools)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)

# Cargar Dataset
data <- read.csv("agaricus-lepiota.data", header = FALSE)


# Nombrar Columnas
colnames(data) <- c(
"class","cap_shape","cap_surface","cap_color","bruises","odor",
"gill_attachment","gill_spacing","gill_size","gill_color",
"stalk_shape","stalk_root","stalk_surface_above_ring",
"stalk_surface_below_ring","stalk_color_above_ring",
"stalk_color_below_ring","veil_type","veil_color",
"ring_number","ring_type","spore_print_color",
"population","habitat"
)

# Limpieza de Datos
data[data == "?"] <- NA
data <- na.omit(data)


# Convertir Todo a Factor
data[] <- lapply(data, as.factor)

# Distribución clases
table(data$class)

# Plot 
plot(data$class)

# Barplot
barplot(table(data$class),
        col=c("green","red"),
        main="Distribución de Hongos",
        ylab="Cantidad")

# GGPlot
ggplot(data, aes(x=class)) +
  geom_bar(fill="steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Distribución Edible vs Poisonous")
  
  
# División Train / Test
set.seed(123)

split <- sample.split(data$class, SplitRatio = 0.7)

train <- subset(data, split == TRUE)
test  <- subset(data, split == FALSE)

# Correlaciones
numeric_data <- data.frame(lapply(data, as.numeric))

corrplot(cor(numeric_data),
         method="color",
         tl.cex=0.6)
         
         
# Modelo Ingenuo         
naive_pred <- rep(
  names(which.max(table(train$class))),
  nrow(test)
)

naive_pred <- factor(
  naive_pred,
  levels = levels(data$class)
)


# Limpiar variables sin variabilidad
train <- train[, sapply(train, function(x) length(unique(x)) > 1)]
test  <- test[, colnames(train)]


# Modelo GLM Binomial
glm_model <- glm(
  class ~ .,
  data=train,
  family=binomial
)


# Predicción
prob <- predict(
  glm_model,
  newdata = test,
  type = "response"
)

pred <- ifelse(prob > 0.5, "p", "e")
pred <- factor(pred, levels = levels(test$class))

# MATRIZ DE CONFUSION
resultado <- confusionMatrix(pred, test$class)

resultado

# Accuracy sola
resultado$overall["Accuracy"]


# Sensitivity y Specificity
resultado$byClass[c("Sensitivity","Specificity")]

# Ver distribución predicciones
table(pred)


#Ver distribución real
table(test$class)
